headlines.title: Is Cognizant Technology Solutions (CTSH) Undervalued Following Its New Credit Facilities?
headlines.summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions (CTSH) just locked in a new unsecured credit package that reshapes its access to capital through 2031, while also repaying and replacing older lending facilities. The new unsecured credit facilities land at a moment when Cognizant Technology Solutions has been volatile. The 1-day share price return of 5.15% contrasts with a year-to-date share price decline of 26.17%, while the 1-year total shareholder return is down 10.56%.

headlines.title: Cognizant (CTSH) Stock May Be 47% Below Fair Value After AI Deal Expansion
headlines.summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions has seen its share price fall sharply this year, and that kind of slide naturally raises a pointed question for investors about whether the current valuation still lines up with the cash flows the business can generate over time. With sentiment being reset, the key issue is whether the recent market pricing tells a different story from what its underlying cash generation suggests. The stock is down about 29.

headlines.title: What Is Cognizant Technology Solutions (CTSH) Signaling With Its Latest AI Push?
headlines.summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions (NasdaqGS: CTSH) announced multi-year AI-focused partnerships with Gilead Sciences and SITA. The Gilead agreement targets AI-enabled DevOps and finance transformation programs using Cognizant's cloud and automation capabilities. The SITA collaboration focuses on applying Cognizant's AI tools across global air transport technology systems and related services.

headlines.title: Trump suspended Microsoft's green card program & awarded its CEO, all in the same day
headlines.summary: President Trump honored Microsoft (MSFT) CEO Satya Nadella at the White House while cutting the company's green card employee program on Thursday. The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley go over the details and dive into the broader discussion surrounding H-1B visas.

headlines.title: Rubrik Expands Project Hourglass as Selling Costs Fall Relative to Revenue
headlines.summary: Rubrik (RBRK:NYSE) is handing more of its AI-security push to partners. On October 9, at its GSI Summit in Goa, India, the company expanded Project Hourglass.

description: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation, a professional services company, provides consulting and technology, and outsourcing services in North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Financial Services; Health Sciences; Products and Resources; and Communications, Media and Technology. The company provides services including artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology services and solutions, consulting, application development, systems integration, quality engineering and assurance, engineering research and development, application maintenance, infrastructure, security, and business process services and automation. It also offers AI-led automation, which includes advisory, and process and IT automation solutions designed to simplify and accelerate automation adoption; business process outsourcing services, which help deliver business outcomes including revenue growth, increased customer and employee satisfaction, and cost savings; and Cognizant Moment, a digital experience service that uses AI to reimagine customer experiences and engineer strategies aimed at driving growth. In addition, the company develops, licenses, implements, and supports proprietary and third-party software products and platforms; and develops industry-specific products and services. It offers solution to healthcare providers and payers, life sciences companies, banking, capital markets, payments and insurance companies, manufacturers, automakers, retailers, consumer goods, travel and hospitality, communications, media and entertainment, education, information services, and technology companies, as well as businesses providing logistics, energy, and utility services. The company has a strategic partnership with Uniphore Technologies Inc. for the development of AI solutions that combine small language models and AI agents. Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Teaneck, New Jersey.
